item.title: Vatican confirms controversial restaurant plan for St. Peter’s Basilica terrace
item.description: Several prelates, speaking anonymously, expressed reservations about the idea of groups of visitors eating and drinking above the tomb of St. Peter.

item.title: Florida couple sues IVF clinic after birth of child from another woman’s embryo
item.description: A Florida couple launched a lawsuit against an IVF clinic after the woman gave birth to a non-white child that turned out to have no genetic relation to them.

item.title: Pro-life student appeals to Supreme Court after high school bans club posters
item.description: Alliance Defending Freedom said Noblesville High School violated the constitutional rights of pro-life students when it censored their posters and revoked their club status over messages like ‘Defund Planned Parenthood.’

item.title: Cross-dressing ‘Antifa general’ kicked off Venmo, Instagram after inciting violence in Minneapolis
item.description: A self-described Antifa leader who enjoyed posting videos of himself in women’s clothing says he needs to ‘escape political persecution’ because of the backlash of his own making.

item.title: ICE shooting BACKLASH, IVF baby gene editing?! InFocus
item.description: New video footage reveals that Alex Pretti repeatedly provoked ICE agents before being fatally shot, contradicting initial media narratives. The panel discusses how activist groups are escalating tensions at ICE operations to manufacture outrage while ICE agents are left without political backing. Attention then turns to a disturbing IVF trend allowing parents to select and discard embryos based on physical traits. This practice is condemned as modern eugenics masked by consumer choice and tech

item.title: US Treasury Secretary says Carney’s anti-Trump rhetoric will hurt trade negotiations
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney made some ill-advised remarks at the World Economic Forum regarding trade and a 'new world order.'

item.title: As Gavin Newsom gears up for presidential bid, his waffling on gender ideology will be an issue
item.description: The California governor has said it's unfair for gender-confused males to compete against females in sports while at the same time showing rabid support for the LGBT agenda.
